articles.title: Copel CEO Daniel Slaviero Talks Its Renewable Abilities Before Its Investor Day
articles.summary: In this NYSE Live interview, Daniel Slaviero, CEO of Copel, discusses the company's Investor Day, growth initiatives, hydropower investments, and the future of Brazil's energy sector. Kristen Scholer spoke with Slaviero about electricity demand, infrastructure investment, power generation, privatization, and shareholder value creation. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on Copel's evolution following privatization and the transformation initiatives implemented over the past several years. The interview also explores the company's position as one of Brazil's leading utility providers across generation, transmission, distribution, and energy trading. Another major theme is operational efficiency and the focus on investing in core businesses capable of delivering long-term returns. The conversation further examines growing electricity demand driven by economic expansion, digital infrastructure, data centers, and electric vehicle adoption. The interview also highlights Copel's plans to expand generating capacity through upgrades to existing hydropower facilities. Another key topic is the addition of approximately 2.1 gigawatts of power generation capacity and the strategic importance of that expansion. The discussion also explores how utilizing existing reservoirs and infrastructure can increase energy production while minimizing incremental environmental impact. Additionally, Slaviero discusses the long-term opportunities he sees for both Copel and the broader Brazilian energy market. The conversation further examines the role of infrastructure investment in supporting future economic growth and energy security. Another focus is shareholder value creation through disciplined capital allocation and operational execution. The interview also highlights the importance of maintaining and expanding reliable energy systems as demand continues growing across the economy. Looking ahead, Slaviero expects Copel to continue pursuing growth opportunities across generation, transmission, and distribution while building on the momentum created by its transformation strategy. Throughout the discussion, Slaviero shares perspectives on utilities, energy infrastructure, hydropower, electricity markets, privatization, capital investment, shareholder value, Brazil's economy, transmission systems, and long-term growth.
